Summary: The research paper "Attention Is All You Need" was first published in 2017 by a team of eight scientists and engineers working at Google. This paper introduced the Transformer architecture, which has since become foundational for many modern AI systems. The publication date is explicitly mentioned in multiple sources, including Wikipedia, a blog post by Parseur, and the arXiv repository.

    ## The Foundation of Modern AI

When the Google researchers published Attention Is All You Need in 2017, they introduced a new architecture for machine translation research. Today, it powers nearly every major AI system we use.

Transformers became the foundation for language models that write and reason, vision models that analyze images, speech systems that transcribe audio, document AI that extracts structured data, and multimodal AI systems that combine text, images, and audio. [...] In 2017, a team of eight researchers at Google published a research paper with a bold title: "Attention Is All You Need." At the time, it sounded almost provocative. Most AI systems still relied on older approaches that processed language step by step, one word at a time.

But this paper introduced something entirely new: the Transformer architecture. [...] The 2017 paper Attention Is All You Need introduced the Transformer architecture, the breakthrough behind modern AI systems like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. By replacing slow sequential processing with attention mechanisms, Transformers made AI faster, more parallelizable, and far better at understanding language, images, and documents.

我用自己的话总结了一下：transformer，从NLP领域开启的生成式AI的革命。它的核心就是注意力，最知名的就是论文中的注意力公式。运用注意力机制，建立自然语言的句子/段落的全局视野。获取某token和任意一个token的关联的时间复杂度永远是O（1）。该论文一开始是作为seq2seq，处理自然语言的。它的架构是编码器-解码器架构，然后，采用多头注意力机制，其实就是一个注意力机制做n次，理解的更深更多角度。同时它支持并行。相比于RNN的串行，它的速度并行效率极佳。相比于CNN的视野局限，它直接拥有全局视野，上帝视角。于是，革命开始了。在2017年。

args.query: arXiv "Attention Is All You Need" submission date 2017

observations.content:
Summary: The "Attention Is All You Need" paper was submitted to arXiv on June 12, 2017. The paper, authored by Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar, Jakob Uszkoreit, Llion Jones, Aidan N Gomez, Łukasz Kaiser, and Illia Polosukhin, proposes a novel network architecture based solely on an attention mechanism, which dispenses with recurrence and convolutions entirely. This submission was later spotlighted at NeurIPS 2017 and published in the Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 30 (NIPS 2017).
